title: 122쪽 · 3x BTN Open — SB Call + BB Defense
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: 3x BTN Open — SB Call + BB Defense

You should call and 3-bet much wider and with a different composition of hands, when the small blind is the flatter. The button is Opening a wide range of hands and the small blind is out of position with a capped range (mostly small pairs and weak Broadways). Suited connectors play very well in position, in 3-bet pots, against small pairs and weak Broadways.

Flat with suited A-x and K-x hands, suited gappers, and Suited double-gappers. These hands are now playable because the pot odds you're getting have improved significantly. That being said, they arent great for Squeezing against the small blind’s pocket pair heavy range. Call with them and outperform the small blind in position.
